text.content:
Red skies, and a city rebuilt by hand.

When: 2025 to the 2050s
Where: Night City and the world
Who was involved: The nomad families, the Co-Prosperity Sphere, Night Corp, edgerunners
What it changed: By 2045 the city had twenty-four districts, a crater in the middle, and a Council that mostly worked

The skies turned red with dust, and the city rebuilt itself by hand. Nomad families like the Aldecaldos hauled in the materials. Shinobu Nakagawa talked Japanese firms into the Night City Co-Prosperity Sphere and rebuilt a home for the diaspora, with the Tyger Claws as its sword. Edgerunners did the jobs nobody would sign their name to. Fixie's Couriers carried half the city's messages on bicycles.

The red skies cleared in the fifties. In 2045 Ziggurat switched on the CitiNet, two years early.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 06
